name: GuardPic Image Credit Checker
author: guardpic

sections.description:
GuardPic Image Credit Checker is a free WordPress plugin that helps site owners, bloggers, publishers and content teams review Media Library images and identify images that may be missing approved credit wording.

The plugin scans Media Library images locally and checks configurable fields such as title, caption, description, alt text, metadata, filename and file URL.

The plugin includes a professional admin dashboard, a dedicated scan and findings page, a settings page for custom credit phrases and an upgrade comparison page for GuardPic Starter and GuardPic Pro.

The admin interface includes seven languages:

  • English
  • Hebrew
  • Arabic
  • Spanish
  • French
  • Russian
  • Chinese

Hebrew and Arabic include RTL display support.

Important: GuardPic is a technology tool for identifying potential image credit and rights risks. It does not provide legal advice and does not guarantee protection from copyright claims.

Features

  • Scan Media Library images for approved credit wording.
  • Detect images without recognized approved credit wording.
  • Manage your own custom credit phrase list.
  • Choose which image fields should be checked.
  • Dedicated GuardPic dashboard.
  • Separate scan and findings page.
  • Separate settings page.
  • Information page describing optional GuardPic Cloud plans and external cloud services.
  • Multilingual interface in 7 languages.
  • RTL support for Hebrew and Arabic.
  • Official GuardPic logo inside the plugin admin pages.
  • Installed version display in settings.
  • DD-MM-YYYY date display format.
  • Protection against running the free plugin alongside the paid GuardPic plugin.

Privacy

By default, the plugin does not send anonymous usage reporting data to GuardPic.

The settings page includes an optional checkbox that allows the site owner to enable anonymous installation and basic usage reporting. When enabled, the plugin may send basic technical metadata to GuardPic servers, including the plugin version, WordPress version, PHP version, selected interface language, active theme, multisite status, selected scan fields and basic scan/finding counters. The report does not include the site URL, home URL or admin email address.

The free plugin does not send passwords, payment details or image files as part of this optional usage reporting.

This optional reporting helps GuardPic understand free plugin adoption and improve product quality.

GuardPic Cloud plans

The plugin may show information about optional GuardPic Cloud plans. These plans are separate services hosted outside WordPress.org and provide cloud processing workflows such as OCR, AI risk analysis, external comparison, quarantine workflows, scheduled background scans, reports and alerts. The WordPress.org plugin remains fully functional for its included local Media Library credit checks without requiring a license key.

External services

This plugin can optionally connect to the GuardPic service at https://app.guardpic.com/ for anonymous installation and basic usage reporting. This reporting is disabled by default and is only used if the site administrator enables it in the plugin settings.

When enabled, the plugin sends a lightweight report to https://app.guardpic.com/wp-json/guardpic/v1/free-install/report. The report may include an anonymous installation UUID, plugin version, WordPress version, PHP version, selected interface language, active theme name/version, multisite status, event type, selected scan fields and basic scan/finding counters. The report does not include the site URL, home URL or admin email address.

The plugin does not send passwords, payment details or private image files as part of this optional reporting.

This service is provided by GuardPic. Terms of Use: https://app.guardpic.com/terms/ Privacy Policy: https://app.guardpic.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP through WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open the GuardPic menu in the WordPress admin panel.
  4. Configure approved credit phrases in GuardPic > Settings.
  5. Choose whether to enable optional anonymous usage reporting.
  6. Run a scan in GuardPic > Scans & Findings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin provide legal advice?

No. GuardPic is a technical tool that helps identify potential image credit and rights risks. It does not provide legal advice and does not guarantee protection from copyright claims.

What is included in the free version?

The plugin includes local image credit checks, custom credit phrase rules, a multilingual admin interface, and a scan and findings page.

What is the difference between Free, Starter and Pro?

Starter and Pro are separate GuardPic Cloud service plans. They provide external cloud processing workflows such as OCR, AI Risk Analysis, visual analysis, external comparison, quarantine, scheduled scans and reports.

Does the plugin send data to GuardPic?

Not by default. Anonymous usage reporting is optional and can be enabled from the plugin settings page. When enabled, the plugin sends basic technical metadata and scan/finding counters, but it does not send passwords, payment details or image files.
sections.changelog:
0.1.15

  • Updated the documented GuardPic Terms of Use and Privacy Policy links to the live public legal pages.
  • Reduced the optional usage-reporting payload by removing site URL, home URL and admin email hash fields.
  • Reduced upgrade prompting by removing the dashboard upgrade strip and the Plugins screen upgrade action link.
  • Preserved the WordPress.org review fixes for scan limits, enqueue usage and external-service documentation.

0.1.14

  • Removed the local 50-image scan limit to comply with WordPress.org trialware guidelines.
  • Updated local scan wording so the WordPress.org plugin is presented as fully functional for its included Media Library checks.
  • Replaced inline admin style output with wp_enqueue_style() and wp_add_inline_style().
  • Added an External services section documenting optional GuardPic usage reporting, including Terms of Service and Privacy Policy links.
  • Updated plugin version to 0.1.14.

0.1.13

  • Removed Plugin URI header because WordPress.org requires Plugin URI and Author URI to be different when both are provided.
  • Kept Author URI pointing to the official GuardPic website.
  • Preserved all Plugin Check fixes from version 0.1.12.

0.1.12

  • Fixed Plugin Check output escaping findings.
  • Added nonce-protected admin action notices.
  • Improved sanitization for settings form input.
  • Removed manual translation loading that is not needed for WordPress.org-hosted plugins.
  • Updated Tested up to value for the current WordPress version used in Plugin Check.

0.1.11

  • Added an explicit opt-in setting for anonymous usage reporting.
  • Disabled anonymous reporting by default for better WordPress.org privacy compliance.
  • Added multilingual labels and explanations for the optional reporting setting.
  • Updated readme.txt with a clear Privacy section and FAQ.
  • Updated plugin version to 0.1.11.

0.1.10

  • Updated scan date display format to DD-MM-YYYY, for example 02-06-2026.
  • Existing saved scans are displayed in the new date format without changing stored data.
  • Updated plugin version to 0.1.10.

0.1.9

  • Added the official GuardPic logo to the free plugin admin pages, matching the commercial plugin branding.
  • Added the installed plugin version display inside the Settings page.
  • Updated plugin version to 0.1.9.

0.1.8

  • Added anonymous free-install tracking report to GuardPic Cloud for adoption monitoring.

0.1.7

  • Updated the plan comparison table to match the official GuardPic Starter and Pro offering.
  • Added an official token usage table.
  • Updated upgrade URLs to the official GuardPic Starter and Pro product pages.

0.1.6

  • Improved admin contrast for hero buttons, notices, cards, tables and secondary text.
  • Fixed saved-settings notices that could appear as white text on a white background.

0.1.5

  • Professionalized the free plugin admin area.
  • Added top-level GuardPic menu with submenus.
  • Added Dashboard, Scans & Findings, Settings and Upgrade pages.
  • Added plan comparison table for Free, Starter and Pro.
  • Added configurable scan fields.

0.1.4

  • Fixed upgrade links to use https://app.guardpic.com/.

0.1.3

  • Moved plugin from Tools to a top-level GuardPic menu.
  • Added upgrade boxes for Starter and Pro.

0.1.2

  • Added internal multilingual interface support.

0.1.1

  • Added protection against running the free plugin alongside commercial GuardPic/Image Credit Guardian plugins.
